## Problem
Describe the observable problem without prescribing a solution unless the decision is already fixed.

## Evidence / current behavior
Facts, reproduction, analytics or relevant source links.

## Outcome / acceptance criteria
Observable conditions that define success.

## Constraints
Platform, UX, performance, SDK, compatibility, security or product constraints.

## Verification
How completion must be proven (tests, runtime QA, screenshots, logs, audit, etc.).

## Risk
Low / Medium / High / Critical

## Out of scope
Explicitly list what must not be changed.
